title: From Language-Specific to Cross-DSL: Semantic-Role-Guided Model Completion with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid emergence of large language models (LLMs), trained on vast and diverse corpora, has positioned them as a promising source of domain knowledge to assist modelers. However, leveraging LLMs for model completion remains challenging: suggestions must respect both the syntax of a domain-specific language (DSL) and the intended domain semantics, while remaining consistent with an evolving model. This paper presents RAFiC, an LLM-based approach for iterative domain model completion that generalizes across DSLs. It drives completion using metamodel information to ensure syntactic validity and enriches prompts with semantic-role annotations to better capture the intended modeling role of DSL elements. The approach provides context-aware, incremental guidance during model construction. translated_title: 从特定语言到跨DSL：基于语义角色引导的LLM模型补全
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在海量且多样化的语料库上训练而成，其迅速兴起使其成为协助建模人员获取领域知识的一个有前景的来源。然而，利用LLM进行模型补全仍然充满挑战：其给出的建议必须同时遵循领域特定语言（DSL）的语法和预期的领域语义，并与不断演化的模型保持一致。本文提出了RAFiC，这是一种基于LLM的迭代式领域模型补全方法，可泛化应用于不同的DSL。该方法利用元模型信息来驱动补全，以确保语法的有效性，并通过语义角色标注来丰富提示词，从而更好地捕捉DSL元素的预期建模角色。该方法能够在模型构建过程中提供上下文感知的增量式指导。我们通过对三种DSL（每种DSL包含两个场景）开展基于消融的对比研究来评估RAFiC，以分离出语法和语义（两方面）各自的贡献……
tldr: 本文提出了RAFiC——一种可跨DSL泛化的基于LLM的迭代式领域模型补全方法，通过元模型信息保证语法有效性，并借助语义角色标注丰富提示词以捕捉建模意图，在模型构建过程中提供上下文感知的增量式指导。
en_tdlr: RAFiC is an LLM-based approach for iterative, cross-DSL domain model completion that uses metamodel information to ensure syntactic validity and semantic-role annotations to capture intended modeling roles, providing context-aware incremental guidance during model construction.
